rules.heading: THE THINGS WHICH SHOULD NOT BE DONE IN THE COMBUST ETC. STAGES OF JUPITER AND VENUS
activities: building and using of a small well
beginning and ending of a vrata
coming in of a newly wedded wife
learning the first lesson from the guru
first going to a place of pilgrimage

planetary.freeform: When Jupiter and Venus are in old age, in combustion, or in childhood stage, and during Kshaya (intercalary loss) or Mala (additional/leap) month.

rules.notes: Various major sacraments, construction works, and journeys are prohibited during the old age, combustion, or infancy stages of Jupiter and Venus, as well as during Mala or Kshaya months.

rules.heading: THE DEFECTIVE PERIOD WHEN JUPITER IS THERE IN THE SIGN OF LEO OR CAPRICORN, OR WHEN HE IS RETROGRADE OR ATICHARI OR WHEN HE COMBINES WITH THE SUN

planetary.freeform: When Jupiter is in the sign of Leo or Capricorn, or is retrograde, atichari (accelerated motion), or combust/combines with the Sun.

rules.notes: All deeds prohibited during combustion of Jupiter also apply when Jupiter is in Leo, Capricorn, retrograde, atichari, or with the Sun.
